title: Same Recipe, Different Chocolate Structure
caption:
The recipe can stay the same while cocoa-butter crystals and the larger fat-crystal network rebuild differently. Tempering guides that rebuilding. Simplified explanatory models; this is not a tempering tutorial.

Original Magnivis visuals with synthetic narration.
